name: Summer Circus Spectacular
venue: Historic Asolo Theater at The Ringling
blurb: Last call: The Ringling and The Circus Arts Conservatory wrap their summer run on Aug 8, and the show's second half brings a fresh international cast - Cyr wheel aerials, contortion, hand balancing, mime and clowning packed into one air-conditioned hour inside the Historic Asolo Theater. Tickets run $15-$20, and the Circus Museum can be added the same day for a few dollars more. Saturday Aug 8 is the final performance of the season.

name: Derek Hough - Symphony of Dance: Encore
hours_label: 7 PM, doors 6 PM · Tickets from $56 (all-in pricing)
blurb: Six-time Dancing with the Stars champion and four-time Emmy winner Derek Hough brings his Symphony of Dance: Encore tour to the purple shell on the bayfront. Expect world-class choreography spanning ballroom, tap, salsa and hip-hop, staged with live music and creative direction from Emmy-winning duo NappyTabs. Tickets start around $56 all-in; the VIP packages are already sold out.
photo_credit: Photo: Van Wezel Performing Arts Hall

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
venue: Downtown Sarasota - Lemon Ave & Main St
blurb: Downtown Sarasota's Saturday institution fills Lemon Avenue and Main Street with local produce, seafood, baked goods, flowers, coffee and live music. Free to browse; come early for parking and the cooler part of the morning. An easy way to feel out the downtown neighborhood if you're house-hunting.

name: Siesta Key Drum Circle
venue: Siesta Beach, south of the pavilion
hours_label: Starts ~1 hour before sunset (around 7 PM) · Free
blurb: Every Sunday a crowd of drummers, dancers, hoopers and fire spinners gathers on the quartz sand just south of the Siesta Beach pavilion to play the sun down. Free, informal and welcoming - bring a chair, a drum, or just watch. One of the most iconic scenes on the Key.
